description: List the crypto addresses added to or removed from the OFAC SDN list since a date, with each party's name, programs and asset, and the two list versions compared (publication date, hash, address count). Read-only. Built from the daily list snapshots this server stores, looks back at most 90 days, and states what period the stored history covers. Free, no sign-in needed.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter such as ETH, USDC, XBT or TRX. Totals and lists then cover that asset only. Letters and digits only, 2 to 10 characters.

lists.description: Lists to report on. Defaults to ["ofac_sdn"]. Only the OFAC SDN list has stored history; the others are named in unavailableLists.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text answer. full returns the complete JSON as text. The structured result is the same either way.

since.description: Start date as an ISO date, such as 2026-10-01. Looks back at most 90 days. An earlier date is moved to 90 days back, and the result says so.

name: sanctions_list_changes

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

added.description: Addresses in the newest version and not in the earlier one, at most maxItemsPerSide.

addressCaseUnknown.description: True when the address comes from an older snapshot that kept it lower-cased only; match it without regard to case.

asset.description: Asset or network ticker the list gives for the address.

listedOn.description: Date the entry was listed, when the list gives one.

programs.description: Sanctions programs the party is listed under.

after.description: The newest list version, or null when there is none.

asset.description: The asset filter applied, or null.

addressCount.description: Number of distinct crypto addresses in this list version.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the sorted address entries in this snapshot.

listSha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded list file, when it was stored with the snapshot.

publishedAt.description: Publication date of the list as OFAC states it, when known.

snapshotDate.description: Date the snapshot is stored under, the list's publication date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before.description: The list version the comparison starts from, or null when there is none.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

coverage.description: What period the stored history covers.

historyStartsOn.description: Date of the oldest stored list version.

latestSnapshotOn.description: Date of the newest stored list version.

status.description: full: history reaches back to the start date. partial: history starts later. none: no usable history.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

list.description: The list these changes are from.

maxItemsPerSide.description: The cap on added and on removed.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

removed.description: Addresses in the earlier version and not in the newest one, at most maxItemsPerSide.

requestedSince.description: The start date that was asked for (YYYY-MM-DD).

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

since.description: The start date used (YYYY-MM-DD), after the 90 day limit was applied.

statement.description: Plain statement of what was compared and what period is covered.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

totals.description: Exact counts, including items beyond the cap.

truncated.description: Whether the added or removed array was cut at the cap.

unavailableLists.description: Requested lists that have no stored history.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.

title: Sanctions List Changes
